confirmed.title: Quantity limits can apply across account, payment and address
confirmed.details: Walmart may restrict quantities by person, household or order, including shared accounts, payment methods and billing or shipping addresses. Its policy also permits restrictions on dealers or resellers.
confirmed.planningImpact: Review the published item and household restrictions before planning quantities. Separate profiles do not establish separate purchase allowances.

confirmed.title: Queue activity does not confirm a product launch
confirmed.details: Pokémon Center says a queue does not necessarily signal a launch and does not guarantee availability. Keep the queue page open without refreshing. Follow product-page quantity limits and do not mix preorder and non-preorder items in one cart.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm each product identifier and cart eligibility before SKU selection. Plan preorder and in-stock items separately under the published checkout rules.

confirmed.title: Membership eligibility and warehouse checkout
confirmed.details: Costco memberships are not transferable. Warehouse entry and checkout require the membership card. Online and warehouse prices can differ, and nonmember online eligibility applies only to certain merchandise.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm the item number, membership eligibility and whether the offer is online or warehouse-specific before planning quantities.
checks: Verify the exact item page and any limit per membership or household.

confirmed.title: Membership and club-specific availability
confirmed.details: Sam’s Club membership cards are non-transferable. Merchandise is subject to availability, and available quantities may vary by club and date.
confirmed.planningImpact: Verify the item number, membership eligibility and fulfillment channel before planning a drop. Do not treat a local club report as nationwide online stock.
